questions.original_semantic_description: A university is managing its courses and students in a database. Each course has attributes such as CourseID, CourseName, and Credits. Students have attributes like StudentID, Name, and Major. Each student can enroll in multiple courses, and each course can have multiple enrolled students. The university also tracks enrollments with attributes such as EnrollmentDate and Grade. Draw an EER diagram representing this scenario clearly showing the entities, relationships, and attributes.
